// reveal
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(function(el){io.observe(el)});

// counters
function count(el){var n=+el.dataset.n,t0=null;if(reduce){el.textContent=n+(n>3?'+':'');return}
 function f(t){t0=t0||t;var p=Math.min((t-t0)/1400,1),e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);el.textContent=Math.round(n*e)+(p===1&&n>3?'+':'');if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f)}
 requestAnimationFrame(f)}
var io2=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){count(e.target);io2.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.6});
document.querySelectorAll('.met b[data-n]').forEach(function(b){io2.observe(b)});
// campaign explorer: fill each entry as details are confirmed
var C=[];for(var i=1;i<=10;i++)C.push({});
var tabs=document.getElementById('tabs'),panel=document.getElementById('panel'),heights=[40,62,48,80,66,92];
function row(k,v,f){return '<dt>'+k+'</dt><dd'+(v?'':' class="na"')+'>'+(v||f)+'</dd>'}
function show(i){var c=C[i];
 [].forEach.call(tabs.children,function(b,j){b.setAttribute('aria-selected',j===i)});
 var shot=c.img?'<img src="'+c.img+'" alt="Campaign '+(i+1)+' screenshot">':'<em>SCREENSHOT COMING SOON</em><div class="bars" aria-hidden="true">'+heights.map(function(h,j){return '<i style="height:'+((h+i*7)%70+25)+'%;animation-delay:'+j*80+'ms"></i>'}).join('')+'</div>';
 panel.style.animation='none';panel.offsetWidth;panel.style.animation='';
 panel.innerHTML='<h3>Campaign '+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')+'</h3><div class="shot">'+shot+'</div><dl class="kv">'+
  row('CLIENT',c.client,'To be added')+row('OBJECTIVE',c.objective,'To be added')+row('AUDIENCE',c.audience,'To be added')+row('WHAT I DID',c.work,'Setup, targeting, creative, optimization')+row('RESULTS',c.results,'Metric not publicly disclosed')+'</dl>'}
C.forEach(function(_,i){var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.role='tab';b.textContent=String(i+1).padStart(2,'0');b.setAttribute('aria-label','Campaign '+(i+1));b.onclick=function(){show(i)};tabs.appendChild(b)});
show(0);
// card tilt (fine pointers only)
if(!reduce&&!coarse)document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(function(c){c.classList.add('tilt');
 c.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){var r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;c.style.transform='perspective(700px) rotateY('+x*7+'deg) rotateX('+-y*7+'deg) translateY(-4px)'});
 c.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(){c.style.transform=''})});
})();
</script>
</body></html>
